info.title: XamlKeys — static scope audit for XAML resource keys.
info.description: XamlKeys — static scope audit for XAML resource keys in WPF, WinUI, Avalonia and .NET MAUI. Finds dangling {StaticResource} references, duplicate keys, keys shadowed by merge order, and keys nobody uses. Whole project, no app launch, CI exit codes.

options.name: --html
options.description: write a self-contained HTML report (no scripts, no external files)

options.name: --md
options.description: write a Markdown summary (for a pull request comment)

options.name: --msbuild
options.description: also print MSBuild diagnostics for the VS error list

options.name: --baseline
options.description: only report findings that are not in this baseline

options.name: --write-baseline
options.description: write the current findings as a baseline

options.name: --stale
options.description: with --baseline, list entries that no longer occur

options.name: --dialect
options.description: merge-order dialect (default: detected from the project files)

options.name: --min-coverage
options.description: minimum share of merged dictionaries that must resolve (default 80)

options.name: --include-tests
options.description: also scan test projects and fixture folders

options.description:
this text
Exit codes:
0  clean
